title: StockSmart Coverage and VendPoint Retired Item Credits — Coordination Memo
content:
Whether a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program storeroom stands behind a retired item at a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine's ship-to sets a backup share on the vend error credit Corbett owes for the failed vend of that retired item.

**Rule.** The backup share follows the StockSmart program whose status is active at the machine's ship-to: when there is no such program, the share is the no-program share; when that program carries no bin for the retired item, meaning its new-bin entries for the item do not outnumber its bin removal entries for the item, the share is the no-bin share; otherwise there is no share.

**Figures.** The no-program share is 0.1; the no-bin share is 0.05.

**Records read.** The StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program record with status active at the machine's ship-to, and that program's new-bin entries and bin removal entries for the retired item.

| Active StockSmart program at the ship-to | New-bin entries against removal entries for the retired item | Backup share |
|---|---|---|
| None | not applicable | 0.1 |
| Yes | Equal or fewer | 0.05 |
| Yes | More | None |

Hypothetical count: one new-bin entry and one removal entry mean no bin is carried (0.05); two new-bin entries and one removal entry mean a bin is carried (none).
